run.name: PRECISION DRILLING Corp
run.title: CP-OS host session (PDS)
run.summary: Precision Drilling has moderate reported leverage of 1.28x net debt to LTM Adjusted EBITDA, wide covenant headroom and CAD 462.5 million of liquidity, but weakening free cash flow, thin cash and a contested tax reassessment leave the view cyclical. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Same definitions; LTM is Q4 2025 to Q3 2026. Unaudited. Adding lease obligations gives 1.48 gross and 1.43 net. The issuer's own target is net debt to Adjusted EBITDA below 1.0 times on its definition; the issuer does not print the ratio value in the supplied reports.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Audited annual statements, debt agreements, customer data and ownership information are not supplied, so legal terms and concentration cannot be tested.
CP-1 main limitation: FY2025 audited statements, debt agreements and several FY2025 flows are not supplied, so LTM cash interest and free cash flow cannot be completed.
